instruction: Enable the automatic screen brightness adjustment setting in the system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic screen brightness adjustment by setting ambient-enabled to true. The evaluator verifies the gsettings value is 'true'. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts system setting: gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power ambient-enabled
Metric (exact_match) appropriately compares the command output with expected value
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct (includes newline from gsettings output)
Parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' means get_rule returns rules dict, metric accesses rules['expected']
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement (ambient-enabled = true)
Logic will work correctly at runtime: config sets initial state to false, evaluator verifies final state is true
